decks.notes: The key concept of this Bant Control deck is to establish control over the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful card draw/filtering options. The deck aims to control the board state and disrupt the opponent's strategy by utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler. It also incorporates creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath for additional value and disruption. The deck utilizes powerful card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder, along with Sylvan Library, to maintain card advantage and find the necessary answers.

The main concept of this Death & Taxes deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by taxing their resources and locking down their key plays, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures. Cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Aven Mindcensor slow down the opponent's spells, while Flickerwisp and Skyclave Apparition provide removal and disruption. Stoneforge Mystic and equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice provide additional threats and utility. The deck aims to control the game through efficient disruption and strategic creature placement, while keeping up the pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on cheating out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield quickly using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. By doing so, it aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game in just a few turns. The deck also includes cards like Omniscience to further enhance the efficiency of its combo strategy, while utilizing counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its key pieces. The mana base is designed to support the combo and enable it to be executed as quickly as possible.

The main concept of this Aggro - Death's Shadow deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly by playing efficient threats like Death's Shadow, Delver of Secrets, and Gurmag Angler. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Hymn to Tourach, and Daze while protecting its own threats with counterspells like Force of Will. The deck also includes removal spells like Snuff Out, Dismember, and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. Overall, it seeks to control the game tempo while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures. It focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while establishing your own board presence. The deck includes cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares for removal, along with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection. It also includes powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to help you dominate the battlefield. Additionally, the deck uses powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler to further control the game.

The deck focuses on quickly reducing your own life total to enable powerful cards like Death's Shadow and Gurmag Angler, while also using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Stubborn Denial to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to apply early pressure with cards like Delver of Secrets and force the opponent into a reactive position with cards like Daze and Wasteland. The deck has a low mana curve and aims to close out games quickly by overwhelming the opponent with efficient threats and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist, allowing you to mill your entire library. This combo sets up a win condition by casting Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck also utilizes support cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Aether Vial provides additional utility and flexibility in executing the combo while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent to quickly pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and tempo plays like Brazen Borrower while utilizing card draw and selection with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Mishra's Bauble. The deck also aims to maintain card advantage with Standstill and keep opponents off balance with disruptive lands like Wasteland. It is a fast-paced, proactive strategy that aims to win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token, while using cards like Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, and Elvish Reclaimer to tutor for combo pieces and protect them. It also includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Endurance to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also has some control elements with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Mox Diamond, providing a versatile and powerful strategy to win the game.

This Aggro-Maverick Legacy deck focuses on using Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for powerful creatures like Thalia, Knight of the Reliquary, and Endurance to control the board and pressure the opponent. Key cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Solitude provide additional removal and value, while cards like Esper Sentinel and Collector Ouphe disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive elements, this deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their strategy, ultimately leading to a victorious finish.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, using cards like Entomb, Exhume, and Animate Dead. This combo-focused strategy allows the player to bring back intimidating creatures onto the battlefield early in the game, overwhelming their opponent and securing a win. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to control the opponent's hand and protect the combo. With efficient mana acceleration from cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, the deck aims to win through powerful reanimation plays.

The main concept of this deck is to use the combo of [[Painter's Servant]] and [[Grindstone]] to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. The deck includes cards like [[Goblin Welder]] and [[Goblin Engineer]] to set up the combo quickly, while also providing disruption with cards like [[Pyroblast]] and [[Red Elemental Blast]]. Additionally, cards like [[Simian Spirit Guide]] and [[Lotus Petal]] help accelerate the deck's game plan, allowing for explosive plays that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to win in a fast and efficient manner, utilizing its combo pieces to their fullest potential.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and resources through a combination of discard spells like Hymn to Tourach and Inquisition of Kozilek, along with removal spells like Smallpox and Sudden Edict. The goal is to control the board and grind out advantages with planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Liliana, the Last Hope, while generating tokens with Sedgemoor Witch. The deck also utilizes land destruction with cards like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Dark Depths combo as quickly and efficiently as possible. The deck utilizes cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Elvish Reclaimer to search for Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, which can create a 20/20 Marit Lage token in just one turn. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Collector Ouphe and Endurance to control the board and protect the combo. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through the powerful Dark Depths combo while disrupting opponents' strategies.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using creatures like Noble Hierarch, Elvish Reclaimer, and Gaea's Cradle to cast powerful spells such as Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith to search for key creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Snuff Out and Opposition Agent to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast mana generation and powerful threats while using cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide to control the board and gain advantage.

The main concept of this Legacy combo deck is to quickly ramp into and cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn using Show and Tell and Omniscience. Dream Halls can also be used to cast these creatures for free. Atraxa, Grand Unifier can help provide additional mana acceleration. The deck also includes cards like Living Wish and Veil of Summer for protection and consistency. The strategy revolves around quickly putting powerful threats onto the battlefield and overwhelming the opponent before they can respond effectively.
